title: Main menu for my soccer game inspired by PES 12/13
author: ProfessionalElk9705
selftext:
What do you think guys ? been working on this for 2 days i feel like am on 2% with the whole game right now   
Its a 1Vs1 soccer game

comments.author: Intelligent-Cap-8886
comments.body:
Hey man. This is sick.  Would you be interested in a basketball game? I love basketball but 2k has fucked the entire franchise with microtransactions

I'd be keen to help however i can.

replies.author: ProfessionalElk9705
replies.body: Thank you, I appreciate it! Honestly, I'm just a beginner seeing what I can put together. My whole motivation started because EA FC became a terrible game haha, so I completely feel you

replies.author: Intelligent-Cap-8886
replies.body: Yea I already knew why you did it bro. We're all in the same shitty boat at the moment.

comments.author: DiscoverWhereAt
comments.body: Wow this look great, how did you get the animations for the model rigged?

replies.author: ProfessionalElk9705
replies.body: Thanks! I just uploaded my character mesh to Mixamo and used their Auto-Rigger tool to set up the skeleton, then applied their juggling animations directly
